name: Tailscale
description: Join a Tailscale tailnet at container start, using a Pass-sourced (Proton Pass via pass-cli) auth key. Installs a 'tailscale-up' bin intended to be run via postStartCommand.

hostname.description: Hostname to advertise on the tailnet (tailscale up --hostname).

authkeySecretPath.description: pass-cli secret path (pass://<path>) that resolves to the Tailscale auth key.
